changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.14
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_collection_owner_replaceable(tenant, owner_id) no longer treats a curator owner as replaceable: only an owner_id that is not tumbler-shaped is (RDR-229, owner is the source). Same signature, grants and SECURITY INVOKER; no data effect.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.catalog_collection_owner_replaceable(p_tenant text, p_owner text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT COALESCE(p_owner !~ '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)*$', true) $fn$;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.catalog_collection_owner_replaceable(p_tenant text, p_owner text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT COALESCE(p_owner !~ '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)*$', true) OR nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(p_tenant, p_owner) $fn$;

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.14
changeSet.comment: catalog-044's two owner-from-documents trigger functions skip the rewrite when the new owner would land a live, unsuperseded code/docs/rdr collection on a (tenant_id, content_type, owner_id, embedding_model, model_version) tuple another live, unsuperseded collection already holds: the old owner stays and a NOTICE names both collections and the owner not taken. Same signatures and SECURITY INVOKER; no data effect.
